title: OrchestrateDecompositionV1
description: Schema for the orchestrator decomposer output: a project broken into issues with a dependency DAG.

project_title.description: Short title for the project tracking issue.

project_summary.description: High-level summary of the project scope and goals. Posted to the tracking issue body.

id.description: Stable local ID used in dependency_edges (not the GitHub issue number).

body.description: Full issue body with enough context for the AI pipeline to clarify, plan, and implement.

priority.description: Lower is higher priority. Used for ordering within the same wave.

files_touched.description: Optional list of repository-relative file paths this issue intends to edit or create. Used by the planner-side partition guard to detect sibling overlap and auto-serialize conflicting issues into later waves. Omit or leave empty when the scope is not known at decomposition time; the poller will still enforce byte-level partitioning via git merge-tree at merge time.

from.description: Issue ID that must be merged before 'to' can start.

dependency_edges.description: Directed edges: 'from' must reach ai:merged before 'to' is dispatched.
